title: Written Order and Prior Authorization Periods, Wound Care Supply Program
content:
# Written order and prior authorization periods — Wound Care Supply Program

Documentation desk reference for the order, authorization and referral periods of each tier of the Wound Care Supply Program.

| Tier | Written order validity | Prior authorization required | Prior authorization validity | Renewal lead time | Standard decision time | Expedited decision time | Referral documentation window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wound Care Self-Pay Program | 3 months | No | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 30 days |
| Wound Care Commercial HMO Program | 3 months | Yes | 3 months | 14 days | 15 days | 72 hours | 30 days |
| Wound Care Commercial PPO Program | 3 months | No | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 30 days |
| Wound Care Medicare Advantage Program | 3 months | No | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 30 days |
| Wound Care Original Medicare Program | 3 months | No | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 30 days |
| Wound Care Medicaid Program | 3 months | Yes | 3 months | 14 days | 7 days | 72 hours | 30 days |

## Column definitions

- **Written order validity**: the validity of the prescriber's written order, in calendar months counted from the order date.
- **Prior authorization required**: whether the payer requires prior authorization before this product line ships.
- **Prior authorization validity**: the validity of a payer prior authorization, in calendar months counted from the payer decision date, unless the payer's approval states an earlier valid-through date; 0 means no prior authorization on the tier.
- **Renewal lead time**: the earliest point for submitting a prior authorization renewal, in calendar days before the valid-through date of the authorization being renewed; 0 means no prior authorization on the tier.
- **Standard decision time**: the payer's decision time for a standard prior authorization request, in calendar days counted from the request date; 0 means no prior authorization.
- **Expedited decision time**: the payer's decision time for an expedited prior authorization request, in hours counted from submission; 0 means no prior authorization.
- **Referral documentation window**: the time allowed to complete the referral documentation (written order on file and, where required, the prior authorization decided), in calendar days counted from the program's enrolled date.

## Reading the table

- Prior authorization is required on exactly two tiers, the Wound Care Commercial HMO Program and the Wound Care Medicaid Program; every other tier shows 0 in each prior authorization column.
- The two prior authorization tiers share the 3-month validity, the 14-day renewal lead time and the 72-hour expedited decision time, and differ in the standard decision time: 15 days on the commercial HMO tier, 7 days on the Medicaid tier.
